  AVG(routeLength) as avg_length,
  COUNT(*) as completed_trips

SELECT 
  edge_id,
  AVG(density) as avg_density,
  AVG(speed) as avg_speed,

  AVG(timeLoss) as avg_timeloss,
  SUM(entered) as total_entered
FROM edge_metrics 
WHERE simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_135315_030'

  s.simulation_id,
  s.description,
  COUNT(t.trip_id) as completed_trips,
  AVG(t.duration) as avg_duration,
  AVG(t.waitingTime) as avg_waiting,
